title: Bangladesh Global Study Abroad Cost & Scholarship Dataset (2027)
description:
An open, evidence-verified higher-education cost, scholarship, and visa benchmark dataset compiled for Bangladeshi students, parents, journalists, and education researchers by EduExpress International (https://eduexpressint.com, Dhanmondi, Dhaka).

  • 416 verified active institutions across 12 countries (China (353), Malaysia (15), United Kingdom (8), Finland (6), Hungary (6), South Korea (6), Cyprus (4), Georgia (4), Greece (4), Thailand (4), Croatia (3), Malta (3)).
  • 1974 structured degree & language programs with explicit currency tuition.
  • 1609 itemized non-tuition fee records separating tuition from dormitory, medical insurance, residence permit, health check, and EMGS costs.
  • 737 structured university scholarship tracks with parsed tuition waiver type, dorm/insurance waivers, and separate living stipends.
  • 32-country global Bangladesh outbound matrix (12 EduExpress active destinations + 20 top OECD/regional benchmark destinations) documenting 2026/27 statutory visa solvency rules, Bangladesh Bank AD Student File rules, and 54 Bangladesh-eligible flagship scholarships.

Follows EduExpress's 2-Tier Hybrid Source Governance: high-level regulatory authorities and root institutional domains are cited openly, while deep brochure/policy tracking URLs are monitored privately to prevent link rot and detect updates.
notes: Tuition quartiles include strictly explicit single-year CNY program rows; non-tuition arrival fees and monthly scholarship stipends are separated from tuition and never converted using synthetic exchange rates. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
